CITY COUNCIL MEETING FOR
FEBRUARY 4, 2021 AT 6:00 P.M. WILL TAKE PLACE SOLELY BY
VIDEOCONFERENCE/TELECONFERENCE.
In order to facilitate public participation at
meetings held solely by electronic means, the City will accept public comment in
the following manner:
1. Members of the public may submit comments
of any length up to two hours prior to the start of the meeting, at the
following email address:
correspondence@cityofpasadena.net
Please be aware that, while these comments
will be provided to the members of the body and will become part of the
meeting record, they will not be read aloud. Any comment submitted in this
fashion will be forwarded to the legislative body prior to the start of the
meeting.
2. During the meeting, members of the public
may submit up to 200 words regarding items on the agenda, at the following
webpage:
www.cityofpasadena.net/city-clerk/public-comment
If you wish your comments to be read aloud
during the meeting, please indicate so on the form. If you submit more than
one form, only the first one received will be read aloud. The City reserves
the right to summarize comments if necessary for the orderly and timely flow
of the meeting. All comments in their entirety will become part of the
meeting record and will be forwarded to the legislative body.

CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  February 4, 2021 - 6:00 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

  SPECIAL MEETING
  The virtual meeting was convened pursuant to Executive Order N-29-20 issued by
  Governor Gavin Newsom on March 17, 2020, and was held solely by
  videoconference/teleconference

OPENING:  Mayor Gordo called the special meeting to order at 6:09 p.m. The
  pledge of allegiance was led by Councilmember Williams.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Victor M. Gordo
 Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Andy Wilson
  Councilmember Tyron Hampton
  Councilmember John J. Kennedy
  Councilmember Steve Madison
  Councilmember Gene Masuda
  Councilmember Felicia Williams

  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

  APPLICANT PRESENTATIONS, INTERVIEWS, AND CITY
  COUNCIL SELECTION OF AN APPOINTEE TO FILL A
  VACANCY ON THE CITY COUNCIL, REPRESENTING DISTRICT
  5, PURSUANT TO CITY CHARTER SECTION 404

  Mayor Gordo made introductory comments and provided an
  overview on the City Council District 5 interview and appointment
  selection process. Mark Jomsky, City Clerk, reported that the
  applicants will be interviewed in the following order (by random
  drawing order) : Jessica Rivas, Michael Warner, Martha
  Shenkenberg, and Patrick Amsbry.

  City Clerk Jomsky reported that a number of letters and emails in
  support of the various applicants were received, which were

  In addition, he read aloud comments in support of the various
  applicants from the following individuals:

  David Coher, Pasadena resident

  Councilmember Williams provided a statement regarding knowing
  Ms. Jessica Rivas through her community work, as well as Ms.
  Rivas volunteering on Councilmember Williams' 2019-20 City
  Council campaign; and has provided Ms. Rivas with information
  related to the logistics and experience of the City Council office.
  Councilmember Williams reported that she is not biased towards
  any applicant and will make an informed decision on the information
  presented today.

Council Minutes  3  02/04/2021
   Mayor Gordo reported that he is familiar with all four applicants who
  live in his district, and acknowledged that some have volunteered
  on his Mayoral campaign, and noted that he contacted all four
  applicants to thank them for their interest in serving their
  community.

  In response to Councilmember Madison's concern related to Ms.
  Rivas' and all other applicants' ability to serve on the City Council,
  Michele Beal Bagneris, City Attorney/City Prosecutor, stated per an
  Attorney General's Opinion, it would not be a conflict for Ms. Rivas
  to serve in her Los Angeles County employment capacity and also
  serve on the City Council. In addition, she stated that the Mayor
  may ask the candidates to confirm they have cleared any conflict of
  interest related to their current employment status.

  Jessica Rivas, Michael Warner, Martha Shenkenberg, and Patrick
  Amsbry, District 5 applicants, provided an overview of their personal
  and professional experiences, and responded to questions asked
  by each member of the City Council.

  Following all presentations and interviews, the City Council
  deliberated on the qualifications of each applicant for the District 5
  vacancy. The Mayor and City Council each noted with admiration
  the strength of the applicant pool, and congratulated Jessica Rivas,
  Michael Warner, Martha Shenkenberg, and Patrick Amsbry for
  representing District 5 in such a positive and distinguished manner.

  MOTION:  Following discussion, it was moved by Councilmember Hampton,
  seconded by Councilmember Kennedy, to nominate Mrs. Martha
  Shenkenberg as City Council District 5 Representative.
  (MOTION WITHDRAWN)

  MOTION  Following further discussion, it was moved by Mayor Gordo,
  seconded by Councilmember Madison, to nominate Ms. Jessica
  Rivas as City Council District 5 Representative:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Hampton, Kennedy, Madison,
  Masuda, Williams, Vice Mayor Wilson, Mayor Gordo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None
  ABSTAIN : None

  Mayor Gordo expressed his strong appreciation to Michael Warner,
  Martha Shenkenberg, and Patrick Amsbry for their willingness to
  serve their community and the City.

  The City Council congratulated and welcomed Ms. Rivas as the
  newly appointed Pasadena City Councilmember for District 5.

Council Minutes  4  02/04/2021
   OATH OF OFFICE ADMINISTERED TO NEWLY APPOINTED
  DISTRICT 5 COUNCILMEMBER BY CITY CLERK

  City Clerk Jomsky administered the oath of office to Jessica Rivas
  as Pasadena City Councilmember representing District 5.

  Ms. Rivas thanked the City Council and the community for the
  opportunity to serve her community and the residents of District 5.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council
  adjourned at 9:09 p.m.

  Victor M. Gordo, Mayor
  City of Pasadena
